arguments.command:
python3 -c "
from icalendar import Calendar
with open('project_kickoff.ics', 'rb') as f:
    cal = Calendar.from_ical(f.read())
for component in cal.walk():
    if component.name == 'VEVENT':
        print('Event:', component.get('summary'))
        print('Start:', component.get('dtstart').dt)
        print('End:', component.get('dtend').dt)
        print('Status:', component.get('status'))
        print('Duration:', component.get('dtend').dt - component.get('dtstart').dt)
        print('Alarms:', len([c for c in component.subcomponents if c.name == 'VALARM']))
print('ICS file is valid.')
" 2>&1 || echo "icalendar library not available; skipping validation."
